name: blast_radius
description: Compute the blast-radius priority tier for a proposed TOPICS.md entry. Returns how many existing concept/report files reference the given keywords, the computed priority (P1/P2/P3), and the list of affected files. Always call this before assigning a priority to a new topic.

keywords.description: One or more search keywords. Use the most specific terms for the topic (e.g. ['Keycloak', 'realm', 'LDAP sync'] for a Keycloak topic).

examples.description: Check blast radius before adding a new SkillClaw topic
Check blast radius for a high-impact topic
